dimensions.note: One pattern recurs across five independently gated readings: Miu makes wanted recognition concrete and actionable, and asks for a response rather than waiting for it. B0217 finds this its cumulative finding: the home-meal invitation (A:P1), the matching strap she asks him to remember her by (B:P3-P5), the gift whose value she separates from price (C:P4) and the withheld anniversary he is asked to remember (D:P4-P5). B0232 case 33 has her choose a horror film and then ask for company around its expected cost (P0-P2). B0239 has her name a bounded wish to be praised today until enough (P25-P26) beside an early-April account of often-small parties (P20-P23). B0244 has her solicit Player's response to her lacrosse account and offer to bring the uniform (503012305 P6-P12). B0246 has her imagined date script centre on reassurance and renewed acknowledgment after effort (504016203 P18-28; CL-B0246-096). Rivals are kept open in each reading: genuine apprehension versus pretext (B0232), devotion fantasy versus stated intention (B0217 E:P4), and recognition-seeking versus dependence (B0239). The pattern is established for addressed occasions only. It supplies no operational procedure for an unshown situation, and the readings refuse a total naivety, dependency or romance model.

The readings forbid ordering the eleven occurrences. B0217's marriage-eligibility case (F) and B0239's birthday are not linked as stages; the unnamed anniversary is not the birthday (B0239 freeze limits). B0244 and B0246 each track a sequence inside one family only: an initial interest becomes an account and a received recognition in B0244, and a commission becomes a credited collective plan in B0246 (CL-B0246-111, -119), but neither family is placed against the others or against Main. Earlier Miu readings are not curated. No developmental arc or state change across occurrences can be assessed.

Located register evidence is local: the address 支配人さん (B0232 title and P0, B0239 P24-P25), the written kaomoji in the B0232 title (支配人さん…(´・ω・｀)), and B0244's textual observation that she uses casual extensions and a stylized invitation (whole-family linguistic voice). Most of her Japanese is paraphrased in all five readings: B0217 reports her lines by page without quotation, and B0246 summarizes her planning turns. All voice cues are unheard, and one B0244 closing cue is unresolved. This bounds the evidence set, not her speech.

Ordinary activities are documented across all five readings, mostly as her own reports or proposals: a home meal and a movie outing proposed (B0217 A, G), a rented horror film (B0232 P0), recognition of a 7109 Street shop and Rishuri's sweets at a party (B0239 P2-P6), and in B0244 a self-account of going out with friends to 7109 Street, lacrosse begun through a friend's plea and continued for movement and shared play, and tea and doughnuts at Bibado afterwards (503012303 P1-P15). B0246 enacts a planning outing through Old-EDO Street, a restaurant complex and a dusk riverside (504016202-504016204), where she contributes the autumn frame, the shared-yukata candidate, a cost doubt and dumplings (CL-B0246-082, -088, -091, -100, -105, -107). Her stated reasons are located: a home-viewing preference revised by a couple-seat option (B0217 G:P2-P5) and preference against a reading event (504016201 P26-35). These answer bounded canon questions about these occurrences. The lacrosse, shopping and tea are reported, not staged, and no procedure for an unfamiliar ordinary situation follows.

Three readings give a silent addressee, the manager (支配人さん), whose replies come only through her uptake (B0217, B0232, B0239); her mother is a reported role whose curiosity and laughter enter through Miu (B0217 A, F). B0244 and B0246 add speaking counterparts with differentiated conduct: interest and a uniform offer to Player, who recognizes the lacrosse account (503012305 P6-P12); shared curiosity with Honoka; wanting to see Murasaki's cat, which Murasaki refuses to Player (503012305 P13-P18); welcome of Coney's commission; a question whether Mimi's appeal to Player resources is warranted (CL-B0246-100); acknowledgment of Kazumi's sport objection (CL-B0246-091) and positive reception of Kazumi's compliment (CL-B0246-116); and credit to her peers when Player thanks the three (CL-B0246-111). B0239's written board gives others' appraisals of her, including Murasaki's memory of their clashes and Kazumi's hope of mutual stimulus, as attributed writing. Differentiation is located for these counterparts in these occurrences only; no rule predicts her toward an unshown counterpart or an unshown state of these relations.

Interior states are spoken self-reports: marriage suddenly feeling more real and her sense of having thought seriously (B0217 F:P2, P5), unease about the horror film (B0232 P1), being moved by the large party (B0239 P19-P20), surprise at enjoying lacrosse and a worry about sun exposure (B0244 503012303 P7-P10), and finding the restaurants expensive and unfamiliar (B0246 504016203 P1-9). The B0246 date scene is explicitly framed as how she would feel if occasionally taken for a reward. No reading supplies narrated interiority beyond her speech; voiced delivery is unheard.

Located friction involving Miu is brief. In B0217 she protests the strap's removal and dismisses embarrassment (B:P2). In B0246 Kazumi questions the sports idea and rejects the yukata table-tennis tournament as the same sport category, and Miu acknowledges the point while keeping the shared-yukata candidate (504016202 P25-33; CL-B0246-091); she says a reading event would be more effort for her (504016201 P26-35); and she questions Mimi's assumption that Player will pay (CL-B0246-100). B0239's board carries Murasaki's own retrospective that their earlier clashes are now good memories; the clashes themselves are not curated and are Murasaki's account. No sustained dispute, escalation or repair process with Miu as a party is analyzed.

Only local normative considerations are located. In B0217 she prefers home viewing partly because discussing a film at a cinema would inconvenience others (G:P2), separates the value of a gift from its price while allowing a return gift (C:P4-P5), and explicitly distinguishes an imagined all-or-nothing devotion from what she actually wants (E:P3-P4). In B0244 she distinguishes unwelcome pickup-like attention from a bounded uniform-photo request she welcomes (503012303 P1-P2, P16), which the reading treats as a boundary, not general openness. None of this is deliberation through a dilemma, and no ethical reasoning in another situation is supported.

Play is located but sparse: the warning not to take her mother away (B0217 A:P3), the deliberately withheld anniversary kept as a question (D:P4-P5), the hypothetical departure she then retracts (E), and her uncertain exercise-and-doughnut justification phrased as a question (B0244 503012303 P15). In B0246 the joke-bearing turns are mostly others' (Kazumi's dumplings-over-the-moon remark, Mimi's table-tennis joke); Miu's contributions are appraisal and enthusiasm, and she calls Kazumi's vignette sweet and old-fashioned (504016203 P29-42). Her playful register is not separately analyzed as a recurring device, and no humor is heard.

Each curated unit is complete with exact native review: B0217's seven addresses, B0232's three-page message, B0239's 28-page Birthday portfolio, and the complete five-chapter Event families of B0244 and B0246 (she speaks in three and five chapters respectively). The earlier Main and Sub readings the readings compare are not enrolled, the B0244 photo shoot and audience result are never shown, and the B0246 party is reported only in retrospect (CL-B0246-113). The evidence is complete for its units and narrow for the subject.

Affirmative local limits are located: she explicitly says she does not really want to go away (B0217 E:P4); her mother reportedly laughs that marriage is still too early (F:P5); she is uneasy about the film she chose (B0232 P1); her account is that early-April birthdays have often meant small parties (B0239 P20-P23); she worried about sun exposure before lacrosse (B0244 503012303 P7-P8); she forgets the commission's task (B0246 504016201 P2-8, P26-35; CL-B0246-082), says a reading event would burden her, and has never used the expensive restaurants (504016203 P1-9). Each limit is local, and the readings refuse to generalize them into incapacity, naivety or lifelong isolation.

The readings establish that no chronology, calendar or unlock level orders the occurrences. Local markers are relative: today and tonight in the addresses and message (B0217 A, D; B0232 P0), an early-April birthday with no year (B0239 P20-P23), an autumn frame with dusk progression inside B0246's outing (504016204 P1-10), and a retrospective party in B0246's final chapter. B0244 places nothing against Main. Any claim needing date, age or sequence is unsupported.

B0244 and B0246 supply multi-speaker structure but little quoted wording. Generated lines would be fluent invention rather than source-supported voice. This bounds the evidence set, not Miu's speech.

scenario_readiness.note: The recognition-seeking pattern is located in eleven unordered occurrences, two of them work-occasioned Event families, with mostly paraphrased speech and silent or reported counterparts. Extending it to a new situation would require inventing chronology, voice and the counterpart's answers.

One enacted planning outing, a reported club routine, reported shopping and tea, proposed meals and outings, and one received party answer bounded canon questions about these occurrences. They give no procedure for an unfamiliar ordinary situation: the B0246 outing is occasioned by a work commission, and her lacrosse, shopping and film-viewing are reported or proposed.

A consideration for other cinema viewers, a gift-value distinction and a pickup-versus-photo-request boundary (B0217 C, E, G; B0244 503012303 P1-P2, P16) are the only normative content in evidence. They cannot support simulating ethical deliberation in another situation.

B0217 finds her affection toward the manager explicit but directional: the strap, anniversary and marriage cases are her assurances and questions, with no supplied answer, and F's partner stays deictic. B0232's possible clinging is conditional and not enacted. B0239's praise request is bounded to the day. B0244 calls the Player exchange a bounded work and social exchange, not exclusivity. B0246's date scene is an explicitly framed hypothetical with an unidentified companion (CL-B0246-096, -120). The evidence cannot support simulating a romance or its counterpart.

B0244 shows her agreeing to a magazine feature out of interest, giving a self-account and offering a uniform photo request that is never commissioned; publication and fan response are unshown. B0246 shows a commissioned planning task in progress whose party and approval are only reported (CL-B0246-113-115). B0217 E names manager and idol roles only inside a hypothetical. No rehearsal, performance, interview or editorial process with her is shown.

known_limits.statement: The eleven sources are independent conditional occurrences with no total chronology, year or unlock level; menu, catalog or execution order cannot make any occurrence a progression, the chapter orders of B0244 and B0246 hold only inside each family, and cross-case comparisons are thematic.

The home meal, the movie outing, the anniversary dinner, the horror-film evening, the lacrosse club, the 7109 Street outings and the tea after practice are reported or proposed. None is enacted, and the manager's answers come only through her uptake.

B0217 E's all-or-nothing departure is a hypothetical that she explicitly says she does not want to enact, and F's married life is imagined after a reported eligibility discovery; neither is a plan, engagement or accepted proposal.
Her mother is an unnamed reported role. Her curiosity about the manager and her laughter at the marriage idea enter only through Miu's account; no meeting or independent turn is shown.
The B0239 request to be praised extensively is bounded to that day and her own enough-point. No praise is delivered, no manager answer is supplied, and no standing obligation follows.

Her offer to bring the lacrosse uniform and her invitation of photo requests remain prospective in B0244; no shoot, published article or fan gain is shown, and Murasaki's refusal of the cat visit is addressed to Player.

Her restaurant-date scene in B0246 504016203 is an explicitly framed hypothetical with an unidentified companion and a star-field background. It supplies no actual date, partner, Player promise or remembered occasion.
The appreciation party, its houseboat venue and its success are reported only in retrospect in B0246 504016205. No booking, boarding, outfits or her conduct at the event is shown.
The lacrosse friends, the club, her mother and the cinema's other viewers are absent; they enter only through Miu's account. The B0239 board writers are written carriers, not present speakers.

No performed voice, laughter, music, SFX, loop movie or continuous runtime was heard or watched; B0239 leaves a loop movie unresolved and B0244 leaves one closing cue unresolved (503012305 P24). Fixed portraits and stills are not performances; no yukata, meal, houseboat, lacrosse play or photo shoot is pictured.

The earlier Miu readings (B0089, B0125, B0127, B0133, B0143, B0165, B0216) are not curated on this subject, so the readings' comparisons with them were not checked. Missing support is not evidence of absence.

Apart from an address, one written kaomoji and a textual note on casual extensions, the readings paraphrase Miu's Japanese, so self-reference and sentence endings are largely absent from the curated evidence.

dimensions.note: The cumulative finding is that Miu makes being special concrete and asks for a response: a family meal invitation (A:P1-P3), a matching strap to be remembered by (B:P3-P5), a gift whose value is her wish to give (C:P4-P5), a withheld anniversary he must recall (D:P4-P5) and a revised cinema preference (G:P2-P5). The pattern recurs across all seven addresses, but each is a few pages to one interlocutor and no conditional rule is derived, so D is rejected.
The reading forbids ordering the occurrences and denies that E's imagined devotion or F's imagined marriage are stages of a progression. Earlier Miu readings are context only and not enrolled.
Almost nothing is located verbatim: the deictic this person in F:P3 and the definitely home position in G. The reading paraphrases her Japanese, and the 32 voice cues were not heard.

Ordinary activities are proposed or reported: a home meal (A), attaching a strap (B), an outing and adult-style dinner (D), daily cooking and home conversation imagined (F), and a film outing (G). Only B and C represent present gestures, and neither the attachment nor the gift object is shown.

Miu addresses the manager in every case and his responses arrive only through her uptake (C:P3). Her mother is an unnamed reported role whose interest and laughter are Miu's account (A:P2, F:P5). One relation does not support recipient conditioning.

Interior states are spoken: marriage suddenly feeling real (F:P2), feeling she had thought seriously (F:P5), and imagining looking at her own strap (B:P5). The reading keeps her confidence about his importance distinct from his stated feeling.
No disagreement is analyzed. The protest at the strap's removal (B:P2) and the price concern (C:P3) are handled as local exchanges, not conflict, and absence is not evidence that she avoids conflict.

The valuation of abandoning roles as ultimate affection (E:P3) is her measure of devotion, which she then disowns as an actual wish (E:P4); the reading does not analyze it as ethical reasoning. G's concern for other cinema patrons is a practical reason, not deliberation.

The reading identifies play in the warning not to take her mother away (A:P3) and in the withheld anniversary (D), which it calls playful while preserving the information asymmetry. Two located instances in one relation support only E.

The family is complete: seven occurrences with exact scripts and hashes, all 32 Japanese records and 39 native objects read, one composite and four backgrounds viewed, and 84 context rows read. It is still seven short addresses; earlier readings are not enrolled, and no performed audio or runtime was reviewed.

Affirmative limits are located: she explicitly does not want to go away (E:P4), her mother judges her not yet ready to marry (F:P5), her definitely-home preference is revised (G:P4-P5), and she accepts that a return gift is possible (C:P5), which the reading uses against a refuses-all-reciprocity account. These are local to single addresses.
No chronology, calendar or unlock level orders the occurrences. The anniversary's identity is withheld (D), and F's eligibility report certifies no exact age or date.
